prices.name: Replace the serpentine (drive) belt
prices.includes: The belt and up to about an hour of labor; a tensioner or idler pulley costs extra (typical = middle of a national quote range)

sources.title: How Much Does a Serpentine Belt Replacement Cost? - Jerry
sources.quote: Jerry has helped over 40,000 customers across the U.S. get accurate repair prices and found that serpentine belt replacements cost between $121 – $174.

sources.title: Cost of Serpentine Belt Replacement - Car Repair and Maintenance - CostHelper
sources.quote: Hiring a mechanic to replace a serpentine belt typically costs about $60-$200 or more.

prices.name: Shop supplies fee (per repair order)
prices.includes: Rags, cleaners and other consumables. Usually 5-10% of labor capped around $30-$50, or a flat $15-$35; about $5-$15 on an oil change. In California a generic "shop supplies" line is not allowed: the supplies used must be itemized (typical = middle of the flat fee)

sources.title: Shop Supplies Charge: The $46,000 Line Item — WickedFile
sources.quote: The most common industry convention is a percentage of the labor total, commonly 5% to 10%, with a per-ticket cap somewhere around $30 to $50.

sources.title: How Much Does an Oil Change Cost? - Jerry
sources.quote: Shop supplies and oil disposal typically add $5–$15

sources.title: Write It Right: Documentation and authorization requirements for automotive repair dealers - Bureau of Automotive Repair
sources.quote: Separate billing in an invoice for items generically noted as shop supplies, miscellaneous parts, fees for electronic communication with the Smog Check database, and the like, is prohibited. (CCR § 3356(g))

prices.name: Replace spark plugs
prices.includes: Plugs and labor for most cars (typical = midpoint)

sources.title: How Much Does a Spark Plug Replacement Cost? - Jerry
sources.quote: the average spark plug replacement cost is about $151–$161 for most cars.

prices.name: Replace a starter motor
prices.includes: Starter, parts and labor; luxury or hard-to-reach at the high end

sources.title: Starter Replacement Costs (2026)
sources.quote: Starter replacement costs typically range from $550 to $2,000, with most standard cars averaging around $650 for parts and labor.

sources.title: How Much Does a Starter Cost? - Jerry
sources.quote: Replacing a vehicle starter typically costs between $400 and $800.

prices.name: Mount and balance a tire
prices.includes: Labor per tire; disposal and TPMS kits may be extra (typical = midpoint)

sources.title: How Much Does It Cost to Mount and Balance Tires? - Jerry
sources.quote: the average cost to mount and balance a single tire is $15–$45 per tire for standard passenger vehicles.

prices.name: Repair a flat tire (patch or plug)
prices.includes: Patch or plug one repairable tire (typical = midpoint)

sources.title: How Much Does a Tire Plug or Patch Repair Cost? - Jerry
sources.quote: a professional inside patch/plug combo repair typically runs $20-$45 per tire.

sources.title: Cost of Flat Tire Repair - Car Repair and Maintenance - CostHelper
sources.quote: Having a flat fixed by a tire or repair shop typically costs $5-$40 for a standard tire and $30-$60 to repair a run flat tire

prices.name: Replace a car tire (per tire, installed)

sources.title: Cost of Tires - Car Repair and Maintenance - CostHelper
sources.quote: CostHelper readers report paying $50-$290 per tire for car tires (in sets of two or four), at an average cost of $139 per tire, installed.

prices.name: Tire rotation
prices.includes: Moving all four tires to new positions; often free where the tires were bought, dealers $50-$90 (typical = middle of the $25-$60 most shops charge)

sources.title: How Much Does a Tire Rotation Cost? - Jerry
sources.quote: Jerry has helped 40,000 customers find fair and accurate prices for their tire rotation needs — we’ve found that it typically costs $25–$60 at most shops.

sources.title: How Much Does Tire Rotation Cost? - Jerry
sources.quote: The average cost of a tire rotation ranges from about $20 to $75, depending on your vehicle, tires, location and service provider.

sources.title: Top 10 Affordable Car Repairs | Endurance Warranty
sources.quote: Price Range: $39-$60 for rotation only; $136-$196 for four-wheel alignment

prices.name: Transmission fluid service (drain and fill or flush)
prices.includes: Automatic transmission fluid drained or exchanged and refilled; a filter and gasket kit adds $40-$120, and a machine flush on some vehicles can reach $700 (typical = middle of a national quote average)

sources.title: How Much Does an Automatic Transmission Fluid Service Cost? - Jerry
sources.quote: an automatic transmission fluid (ATF) service costs between $221–$264.

sources.title: Transmission Fluid Service Cost Estimate - Jerry
sources.quote: A transmission fluid flush costs between $100 to $700 while a transmission fluid change costs $80 to $400.

sources.title: How Much Does It Cost to Flush a Car Transmission
sources.quote: Expect to pay $75-$150 or more for a standard transmission fluid change.

prices.name: Wheel alignment
prices.includes: One alignment; dealers and premium cars at the high end (typical = midpoint)

sources.title: How Much Does a Wheel Alignment Cost? - Jerry
sources.quote: the typical cost of a wheel alignment is $70–$250 depending on the vehicle.

prices.name: Replace windshield wiper blades (pair)
prices.includes: A pair of standard blades; parts stores often fit them free, others charge $20-$25. Beam, luxury or heated blades cost more (typical = midpoint)

sources.title: Cost of Windshield Wipers - Car Repair and Maintenance - CostHelper
sources.quote: A standard replacement blade assembly for the front windshield or a rear wiper on a hatchback or SUV typically costs $7-$20 each, or $14-$40 a pair

sources.title: Top 10 Affordable Car Repairs | Endurance Warranty
sources.quote: Price Range: $20-$70 for DIY replacement; $53-$88 for professional installation
